description: Core rules for sessions and subagents, edit guard, edit tracking, format + validate at turn end.

hooks.command: command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; ROOT=$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" | sed 's|^/\([a-zA-Z]\)/|\1:/|'); node "$ROOT/hooks/session-start.mjs"
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; ROOT=$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" | sed 's|^/\([a-zA-Z]\)/|\1:/|'); node "$ROOT/hooks/session-start.mjs" --subagent
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; ROOT=$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" | sed 's|^/\([a-zA-Z]\)/|\1:/|'); node "$ROOT/hooks/guard.mjs"
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; ROOT=$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" | sed 's|^/\([a-zA-Z]\)/|\1:/|'); node "$ROOT/hooks/track-edit.mjs"
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; ROOT=$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" | sed 's|^/\([a-zA-Z]\)/|\1:/|'); node "$ROOT/hooks/stop-check.mjs"
